implementation_notes: A gem per context, or a top-level module with a single entry file and `private_constant` for internals. Enforce with Zeitwerk autoloading and a rubocop rule banning cross-context deep requires.
idiom_name: gem or top-level module + private_constant internals
code_sketch:
# lib/billing.rb
require_relative 'billing/pricing'
module Billing
  Pricing = Billing::Internal::Pricing
  private_constant :Internal
end
pitfalls: Reopening another context's class to add behaviour (an invisible boundary crossing)
Contexts as namespaces inside one gem so requires never cross a boundary
